config.mode_note: DEMO: the drop operator may file on behalf of a named wallet so that public wallets with real history can be read; windows are in minutes. The canonical instance requires sender == wallet.

vocabulary.question: Was the wallet's first funding transaction sent by a centralised exchange or a bridge? YES only if the funding line's label or pattern clearly shows one, NO if it clearly came from an ordinary wallet or another kind of contract, UNCLEAR if there is no funding line or the label says nothing.
Are the transactions near-identical sequences (same target, same method, same or round values) repeated at regular intervals? NONE, SOME or STRONG.
Does the activity ONLY touch the listed protocol's contracts, concentrated shortly before the snapshot time? NONE, SOME or STRONG.
Does the wallet look like a normal user: varied protocols, varied amounts, irregular timing spread over time? LOW, MEDIUM or HIGH.

config.unclear_note: a rule on an UNCLEAR model finding never fires
config.merkle: leaf = sha256(0x00 || 20 address bytes); node = sha256(0x01 || min(a,b) || max(a,b))
config.coverage: outbound page complete (fewer than 50 items, no next page) or reaching back to the lookback start; earliest-activity page complete or verifiably ascending; otherwise INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY
config.findings_tolerance: each model finding may differ by one bucket; UNCLEAR only matches UNCLEAR; the rule outcome each validator computes from its own findings must be identical, or the round does not settle
config.unresolved_rule: UNRESOLVED only after 3 committed split rounds, each settled only if validators read the wallet, agreed on the evidence and computed a different outcome from the leader's
config.model_sees: the stored history snapshot only (plus contest context on a contest); never the rules, flag or thresholds
